why: CSS rules of a <use>'s classes style the instance where it sets nothing itself. In structure.svg the tile used with class="red" is now filled #d22 instead of black; the old app gives the same output with the class replaced by fill="#d22" on the use. These .fixed files also carry BUG-073 (the switch). use-symbol.svg's class="blue" use is unchanged, since its group sets its own fill.
